monsters.title: Giant rat
monsters.look: a huge, mangy sewer rat the size of a dog, dirty brown-grey fur, long naked pink tail, yellow incisors, small red eyes, hunched on four legs

monsters.title: Kobold
monsters.look: a small scaly reptilian kobold with a rust-red dog-like snout, small horns, yellow eyes, ragged leather scraps, holding a crude rusty short spear

monsters.title: Goblin
monsters.look: a goblin: small, wiry, green skin, large pointed ears, sharp teeth, yellow eyes, ragged leather armour, holding a notched scimitar and a small round wooden shield

monsters.title: Skeleton
monsters.look: an animated human skeleton warrior, yellowed bones, glowing pale blue eye sockets, a dented iron helmet, a rusted shortsword in hand, tattered cloth at the waist

monsters.title: Zombie
monsters.look: a shambling zombie, grey-green rotting flesh, torn peasant clothes, hunched, arms hanging forward, exposed ribs, vacant white eyes, slack jaw

monsters.title: Orc
monsters.look: a brutish orc warrior, grey-green skin, heavy lower jaw with two tusks, black topknot, scrap-iron armour with spikes, holding a big greataxe

monsters.title: Giant spider
monsters.look: a giant cave spider, eight long hairy dark-brown legs, a bulbous striped abdomen, a cluster of glowing red eyes, large dripping fangs; low and wide, legs spread

monsters.title: Ghoul
monsters.look: a ghoul: emaciated grey-skinned undead, stretched over its bones, long black claws, a gaping mouth of jagged teeth, sunken glowing yellow eyes, hunched, scraps of burial shroud

monsters.title: Ogre
monsters.look: a huge ogre, pot-bellied, dull yellow-brown warty skin, small angry eyes, an underbite with tusks, a ragged animal-hide loincloth, holding a big spiked wooden club

monsters.title: Owlbear
monsters.look: an owlbear: the body of a huge brown bear covered in feathers and fur, the head of an owl with a sharp hooked beak and wide yellow eyes, big clawed paws, rearing up on its hind legs

monsters.title: Troll
monsters.look: a tall, gangling troll, mossy green rubbery skin with warts, very long arms with huge clawed hands, a hooked nose, tiny red eyes, tattered hide kilt, hunched, towering over a human
